```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggspatial)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

# 🗺️ Carte de la France
france <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", country = "France", returnclass = "sf")

# 📍 Données des sites, avec points Los Masos légèrement décalés
sites <- data.frame(
  ville = c("Finestret", "Varetz", "Los Masos", "Ille-sur-Têt", "Thurins", "Millas"),
  fruit = c("CH", "BL", "CH and ST", "ST", "all", "ST"),
  lat = c(42.6233, 45.1378, 42.6256, 42.6667, 45.4057, 42.68290233641148), 
  lon = c(2.5833, 1.5000, 2.5225, 2.6167, 4.3829, 2.704289550429724))

# 🎨 Couleurs personnalisées
fruit_colors <- c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red3", "ST" = "darkred", "CH and ST" = "coral3", "all" = "black")

# 🧭 Conversion en objet spatial
sites_sf <- st_as_sf(sites, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# 🗺️ Création de la carte
map <- ggplot(data = france) +
  geom_sf(fill = "grey95", color = "grey50") +
  geom_sf(data = sites_sf, aes(color = fruit), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = fruit_colors, name = "Fruit Type Sampled") +
  geom_text_repel(data = sites_sf,
                  aes(label = ville, geometry = geometry),
                  stat = "sf_coordinates",
                  size = 3.5, nudge_y = 0.15, min.segment.length = 0) +
  # 🧭 Nord simple en haut à droite
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", which_north = "true",
                         style = north_arrow_minimal, height = unit(1, "cm")) +
  # 🧭 Échelle
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2) +
  # 🔍 Vue plus large : moitié Sud
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-0.5, 5.5), ylim = c(41.5, 45.5), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  legend.position = c(0.95, 0.05),
  legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3),
  legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"), # = element_blank() if map without grid
  axis.text = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks = element_blank(),
  axis.title = element_blank())

map

ggsave(file =here::here("plots", "Figures","map_fruitSampling.jpg"), plot = map, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")


### All France
# 🗺️ Base map of France
france <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", country = "France", returnclass = "sf")

# 🎨 Fruit color palette
fruit_colors <- c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red4", "ST" = "red2")

# 📍 Sampling sites already defined in `sites` and `sites_sf`

# 🗺️ Create small full-France map
inset_map <- ggplot(data = france) +
  geom_sf(fill = "grey95", color = "grey60") +
  geom_sf(data = sites_sf, aes(color = fruit), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = fruit_colors, guide = "none") +  # same colors, no legend
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-5, 10), ylim = c(41, 52), expand = FALSE) +  # full metropole view
  theme_void()

# 🖼️ Display
inset_map
ggsave(file =here::here("plots", "Figures","map_France_fruitSampling.jpg"), plot = inset_map, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
```
